chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 248 – Ji Ning Forces a Primal Perfection Daoist to Flee!
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning faces Snowfeather Daoist of Snowdragon Mountain in a one-on-one battle. Though swords are outmatched, his Fiendgod speed forces a Primal to retreat. A true Battle of Fame is born.
og_title: Ji Ning vs. a Primal Perfection Daoist – The Battle of Fame
og_description: Snowfeather Daoist came to crush Ji Ning. He left in fear. A Primal perfection Ki Refiner just learned what happens when a Fiendgod closes the distance.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Battle of Fame Begins
twitter_description: Nine years of silent cultivation culminate in a battle that forces a Primal perfection Daoist to flee. The Yan Mountains will never be the same.

lore_anchors.definition: In Xianxia, a battle where a rising cultivator fights an established powerhouse to a standstill or retreat, instantly elevating their status from talented junior to recognized threat.
The highest substage of the Primal Daoist realm, where a Ki Refiner has fully consolidated their soul and foundation, possessing immense power and centuries of experience.
Snowfeather Daoist’s top-grade Heaven-ranked flying swords, capable of transforming into two hundred-zhang-long flood dragons of pure sword-light with nascent intelligence.
The path of physical cultivation, emphasizing regeneration, raw power, and the ability to close distance; Ki Refiners fear them in close combat.
Ji Ning’s movement divine ability from his mother’s Yuchi clan; allows ghost-like speed and instant closing of gaps, devastating against ranged attackers.
One of the top ten divine abilities since Pangu; at the first cycle, it grants Ji Ning power on par with a Primal perfection Daoist, but requires rare Five Elements quintessence to advance.
The legendary sword-art of Immortal Beixing; Ji Ning’s mastery of the fifth stance makes his sword-art superior to Snowfeather Daoist’s in subtlety.
The sentient soul born within an Immortal-tier magic treasure after eons; below that grade, treasures may have nascent intelligence but no true personality or voice.
The number one Fiendgod Body Refining method; at this level, Ji Ning’s physical power matches a Wanxiang perfection Fiendgod.
A weapon bonded to its user’s blood and life force, growing in power by absorbing killing intent; the Northsea Swords are at peak Earth-ranked grade.
